method.stroke: Arc-length-weighted medial-axis diameter; junction/terminal neighbourhoods excluded.
method.units: font units, at a fixed 1000-unit em
method.limitation: Geometry describes thickness, density and contrast; it does not prove equal perceived weight.

characters.label: TU
characters.note: Heavy strokes supported by the measurements; lighter と/つ masters, with the accepted return retained.

characters.label: TI
characters.note: Small horizontal-arm deficit; add at most 2.5 units beneath the arm. The elbow and right stroke stay intact.

characters.label: KWA
characters.note: Heavy upright strokes in わ; reduce its donor from 700 to 600 and slightly lighten く. Keep the continuous sweep.

characters.label: KWI
characters.note: Overall median was close to native く/い, but its upper quartile and reduced components were heavy. Reduce both donor weights.

characters.label: KWE
characters.note: Modest optical reduction in く, the reduced え and its foot; overall width was already near the donors.

characters.label: HWA
characters.note: No whole-glyph thickness excess over ふ. Small optical reduction in わ and shoulder; native ふ body retained.

characters.label: HWI
characters.note: No whole-glyph thickness excess over ふ. Small optical reduction in the reduced い; native ふ body retained.

characters.label: HWE
characters.note: No whole-glyph thickness excess over ふ. Small optical reduction in え and shoulder; native ふ body retained.

characters.label: Glottal YA
characters.note: Native や stroke widths were already close. Relieve only the added mark and its join.

characters.label: Glottal YU
characters.note: Retained as a control.

characters.label: Glottal YO
characters.note: Native よ median was close. Reduce the added mark and some sideways compensation.

characters.label: Glottal WA
characters.note: Retained as a control.

characters.label: Glottal WI
characters.note: Retained as a control.

characters.label: Glottal WE
characters.note: Retained as a control.

characters.label: Glottal N
characters.note: Native ん body retained.

characters.note: Retained as a control.

characters.note: Retained as a control.

characters.label: TSI
characters.note: Whole-glyph median was below native つ; only a small optical reduction of the fuller つ component.
